$$

Simplify both sides:

e^{i(\pi/2 + r\pi/6)} = e^{i2\pi s/3}
$$

Equating angles modulo $2\pi$:

3 + r = 4s + 12k

r = 4s + 12k - 3

3 + r = 4s + 12k

Rearranging:

r = 4s + 12k - 3
